description: Collect a QUEUED what-if: its state (queued | running | done | failed) and, once done, the diff against the canonical run. Pass runId and the experimentId what_if_run returned; omit experimentId to list every what-if asked of this run. The original run is never modified — the experiment lives in its own sandbox.

runId.description: The run's full runId (slug-date-codename) OR just its codename.

name: what_if_result
